article.title: Building a Sustainable Future
article.body: Cities around the world are facing unprecedented challenges as populations grow and resources become less abundant. To build a sustainable future, experts advocate a comprehensive plan that allocates funds to clean energy and public transport. Although the initial cost may seem high, numerous studies confirm this approach is both feasible and viable. A prominent scientist proposed the hypothesis that reducing waste can mitigate climate risks, and subsequent policies implemented her idea. Technology will continue to evolve, but we must not let environmental quality deteriorate. An objective review shows that diverse communities benefit when we eliminate pollution at its source. While change is inevitable, a new paradigm of green living can fundamentally enhance our lives. Prices for renewable energy no longer fluctuate as sharply, and even intricate systems can compensate for past damage. Education should be compulsory so that consecutive generations understand these goals. The plan is ambitious yet clear — ambiguous targets must be avoided if we want measurable progress.
article.translation: 随着人口增长、资源不再丰裕，全球城市正面临前所未有的挑战。为构建可持续的未来，专家倡导一项全面计划，将资金分配给清洁能源与公共交通。尽管初期成本看似高昂，但大量研究证实这一路径既可行又可落地。一位杰出科学家提出假设：减少浪费可缓解气候风险，后续政策采纳了她的构想。技术将持续演进，但我们不能任由环境质量恶化。客观评估显示，消除污染源能让多元社区受益。变革虽不可避免，但绿色生活的新范式能从根本上升级我们的生存质量。可再生能源价格不再剧烈波动，即便复杂系统也能补偿过往损伤。教育应当义务化，让代际相继的一代人理解这些目标。计划宏大却清晰——若想取得可衡量进展，必须规避含糊的目标。
